description:
Position: .Net SSRS Developer 
 Location: Orange, CA 
 Duration: 2 years 
 
 
 Responsibilities include: 
 
 Develop, test, and maintain programming solutions using .NET (C#/VB), ASP, SQL, and Crystal Reports based on the direction of the Applications Programming Manager. This can include developing using established requirements from the Applications Programming Manager or developing according to a sponsor’s request. 
 .NET Portal Development, Reports, Analytics 
 Generate DDL scripts (ORACLE and SQL Server) in order to create or update database objects as needed to facilitate new application deployment, logic, and bug fixes. 
 
 Provide support to user base by addressing programming-related helpdesk tickets, in-person inquiries, and phone calls. In many cases, this involves diagnosing/debugging issues, reviewing existing code, and providing solutions/enhancements & reports. Works well independently in this manner. 


 Syed Mohammad Asif 
 408-775-7468
